name: mixdive-js
description: Mixdive JavaScript SDKs: the browser SDK (web tag + npm), the React bindings, the server SDK and the Next.js bindings.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mixdive/browser && npm run build -w @mixdive/react && npm run build -w @mixdive/node && npm run build -w @mixdive/next
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
